ResearchTabDef.label: Demo research
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Minimal research examples: vanilla prerequisite, independent root, linear chain, fork, conditional fork, and production unlock.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: vanilla prerequisite
ResearchProjectDef.description: Requires vanilla Electricity; demonstrates an edge from a vanilla research into a demo project.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: independent
ResearchProjectDef.description: No prerequisites; demonstrates a root that is independent of the vanilla research chains.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: linear I
ResearchProjectDef.description: Start of a three-step linear demo chain.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: linear II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Second step of the linear demo chain; requires linear I.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: linear III
ResearchProjectDef.description: Third step of the linear demo chain; requires linear II.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: branch root
ResearchProjectDef.description: Start of a demo chain that forks after three steps.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: branch stem
ResearchProjectDef.description: Second step of the branching demo chain.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: branch fork
ResearchProjectDef.description: Third step of the branching demo chain; the next step splits into two.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: branch left
ResearchProjectDef.description: One of two demo branches after the fork.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: branch right
ResearchProjectDef.description: The other demo branch after the fork.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: fork root
ResearchProjectDef.description: Start of a demo chain where the post-fork options differ by prerequisites.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: fork stem
ResearchProjectDef.description: Second step of the conditional-fork demo chain.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: fork + extra prerequisite
ResearchProjectDef.description: Requires the fork stem and the independent demo research.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: fork without extra prerequisite
ResearchProjectDef.description: Requires only the fork stem; no extra research.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Demo: production research
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks a machining recipe that produces industrial components.

RecipeDef.label: assemble demo component
RecipeDef.description: Assemble an industrial component from steel. Unlocked by the production demo research.
